Copernicus DEM GLO-30 over coastal Andhra Pradesh (15-18N, 80-83E), block-
averaged to 225 samples per degree (about 490 m) and stored as float16, so the
terrain tests run on a fresh clone with no network. Tile N15 E082 is open sea
and has no data.
